How would you describe the shape of this distribution?

options.why: Treated the equal class widths as evidence of symmetry, but the frequencies do not form mirrored halves and taper off over a longer stretch to the right.
Named the skew from the side the largest frequencies sit on instead of the side the frequencies trail away to.

questions.solution_text:
The largest frequency is $52$, in the second class, so most of the data sits on the left.
The frequencies fall away through $27, 12, 6, 3$ across the classes to the right.
The tail stretches to the right.
Positively skewed.
